plugin.name: EH WhatsApp Like
plugin.author: Emad Helmy
plugin.description: A WhatsApp-like internal chat system for any UserSpice site: one-to-one conversations, broadcast messages by permission or to a specific user, unread counter, online/offline indicator (watchdog / last_watchdog), a floating button at the bottom right plus a dropdown in the top navbar, and chat/messages pages stored in independent tables with the eh_ prefix.
